key_impacts: 198 people killed in central El Salvador during the floods
More than 100 houses damaged in Fenadesal Sur
Bridges ripped away and homes obliterated along the Acelhuate River in Fenadesal Sur
About 300 residents at risk evacuated to safety in Fenadesal Sur
evidence_snippets: In November 2009 a torrential rainstorm hit central El Salvador; 198 people were killed.
Fenadesal Sur got 14 inches in four hours; bridges ripped away and homes obliterated.
Losses: 30 houses destroyed, 100+ damaged; 300 people made it to safety.

key_impacts: Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in the town of Verapaz
